\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 147-150 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:UR-R155-first-pass-words-from-chapters-147-150}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for February and March.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to tutor, to memorise; to remember, to scream, to smile, to panic
  \item to choose, to change, to borrow, to lend, to save
  \item to cross, to wander, to go for a stroll, to jump, to slip
  \item to dye, to rub out, to print, to sign, to phone
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To tutor? (\textbf{\ur{پڑھانا}}, \emph{paṛhānā}.) To memorise; to remember? (\textbf{\ur{یاد} \ur{کرنا}}, \emph{yād karnā}.) To scream? (\textbf{\ur{چیخنا}}, \emph{chīkhnā}.) To smile? (\textbf{\ur{مسکرانا}}, \emph{muskurānā}.) To panic? (\textbf{\ur{گھبرانا}}, \emph{ghabrānā}.) To choose? (\textbf{\ur{چننا}}, \emph{chunnā}.) To change? (\textbf{\ur{بدلنا}}, \emph{badalnā}.) To borrow? (\textbf{\ur{ادھار} \ur{لینا}}, \emph{udhār lenā}.) To lend? (\textbf{\ur{قرض} \ur{دینا}}, \emph{qarz denā}.) To save? (\textbf{\ur{بچانا}}, \emph{bachānā}.) To cross? (\textbf{\ur{پار} \ur{کرنا}}, \emph{pār karnā}.) To wander? (\textbf{\ur{گھومنا}}, \emph{ghūmnā}.) To go for a stroll? (\textbf{\ur{سیر} \ur{کرنا}}, \emph{sair karnā}.) To jump? (\textbf{\ur{کودنا}}, \emph{kūdnā}.) To slip? (\textbf{\ur{پھسلنا}}, \emph{phisalnā}.) To dye? (\textbf{\ur{رنگنا}}, \emph{rangnā}.) To rub out? (\textbf{\ur{مٹانا}}, \emph{miṭānā}.) To print? (\textbf{\ur{چھاپنا}}, \emph{chhāpnā}.) To sign? (\textbf{\ur{دستخط} \ur{کرنا}}, \emph{dastkhat karnā}.) To phone? (\textbf{\ur{فون} \ur{کرنا}}, \emph{fon karnā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
